parameters.label: Campaign seed
parameters.why: Selects deterministic morphology and run variation. Frozen campaigns declare seeds before outcomes are visible.

parameters.label: Terrain seed
parameters.why: Selects deterministic terrain geometry independently of the controller seed, preventing the policy from keying behavior to a terrain identity.

parameters.label: Limb count
parameters.why: The current SDK evidence boundary is quadruped-only. Other values are roadmap exploration and must be rejected by release claims today.

parameters.label: Locomotion mode
parameters.why: Only the balanced-wave quadruped walking lineage has current physical evidence. Other modes visualize downstream product scope.

parameters.label: Torso length scale
parameters.why: Changes body lever arms, gait timing, and steering normalization. Finite samples do not establish the continuous interval.

parameters.label: Torso width scale
parameters.why: Changes lateral support geometry and hip spacing demand.

parameters.label: Upper-leg fraction
parameters.why: Redistributes total leg length between upper and lower segments, changing reach and knee geometry.

parameters.label: Hip span scale
parameters.why: Changes the support polygon and the moment arms available for lateral stabilization.

parameters.label: Foot radius scale
parameters.why: Changes contact patch geometry. Raw multi-shape contact impulses are not treated as additive support loads.

parameters.label: Front-limb mass scale
parameters.why: Changes inertial asymmetry and the controller's load-transfer problem.

parameters.label: Terrain type
parameters.why: Flat material tests isolate friction. Rough, slope, and step modes are currently exploration until prospectively validated.

parameters.label: Authored friction
parameters.why: The value authored into the engine is distinct from characterized physical response. BW22M published finite Godot/Jolt profiles for fresh values.

parameters.label: Slope
parameters.why: Changes gravity projected along the travel direction. General incline robustness is not established.

parameters.label: Roughness amplitude
parameters.why: Controls the deterministic height-field amplitude in the preview. It is not an input to a frozen campaign unless declared there.

parameters.label: Obstacle height
parameters.why: Represents discrete terrain discontinuities. Current rough-terrain acceptance is false.

parameters.label: External push
parameters.why: Toggles a conceptual disturbance. Push magnitude and timing must be frozen independently before a robustness claim.

parameters.label: Push impulse
parameters.why: A bounded impulse is easier to reproduce than an informal shove. External-push recovery is currently unaccepted.

parameters.label: Sensor noise
parameters.why: Noise must be injected through a declared observation boundary rather than hidden in controller branches.

parameters.label: Noise standard deviation
parameters.why: Defines a reproducible distribution scale. Sensor-noise robustness is currently unaccepted.

parameters.label: Sensor latency
parameters.why: Latency changes feedback phase and must be tested independently before combined-nuisance campaigns.

parameters.label: Sensor latency
parameters.why: Defines an explicit delayed-observation window. No accepted latency campaign exists yet.

parameters.label: Cross-track P factor
parameters.why: Converts lateral position error into a heading correction. BW22L's only arm contrast is 1.0 versus 1.5.

parameters.label: Cross-track V factor
parameters.why: Damps lateral velocity. BW22L holds it at 1.0 so the proportional contrast remains identifiable.

parameters.label: Portable residual scale
parameters.why: Scales the portable stability contribution. BW19V treatment uses exactly 0.5; zero is the policy-relative control.

parameters.label: Maximum steering fraction
parameters.why: Bounds how strongly steering may distort the gait cycle and prevents unbounded corrective commands.

parameters.label: Gait frequency
parameters.why: Changes phase speed. Running is not just a faster walk and requires a separate contact-mode contract.

parameters.label: Stride scale
parameters.why: Changes requested foot excursion. Larger requests can exceed kinematic reach or contact stability.

parameters.label: Physics frequency
parameters.why: Solver timestep changes are experimental factors. Accepted results bind their exact frequency and engine settings.

parameters.label: Run duration
parameters.why: A longer horizon can expose failures that short screens miss. Horizons are frozen before physical execution.
